maker: bell sec.: Hans Miler, Vienna; slide sec.: Nuremberg manufacture, 1700/20
signature: Hans Miler / 1630; on bell-stay and slide-sec., "B" (perhaps owner's initial).
mouthpiece: From a trumpet, Nuremberg type, first half 18c; diam. of bowl 20, diam. of throat 6, diam. of outlet 8, depth of bowl 11.6, total length 96, rim 6; bowl probably bored out slightly at a later date.
remarks: 7 pos.; slide sec. perhaps from workshop of J.L. Ehe II.
